text:
Jordan: Quick SRE async check-in — what I did / blockers / today
Alex M: Did: adjusted nginx upstream timeouts (reduced 503 noise overnight). Blocker: redis alerts are still noisy on shard-3, suspect flapping failover. Today: update alert thresholds + add jitter to probe. @Sam L fyi. :thumbsup:
Priya S: Did: merged kv-cache fix that reduced resident memory on model nodes. Blocker: seeing occasional tail latency spikes for long-context jobs (~99.9th p99.9). Today: kicking off a model-replay against dedicated queue and running latency profiler. Ping @Casey R for canary logs.
Casey R: Ack, will grab canary logs and correlate. Also quick CR ping: PR #412 (https://git.internal/redwood/pr/412) needs a second review for the autopause change. Small snippet to pull recent logs:```bash
kubectl -n model-serving logs -l app=model-canary --tail=200 | grep "latency_ms" | tail -n 50
```
Sam L: Oncall recap: last night we got multiple pages for model-serving-high-latency -> rollback to model-v1.3 mitigated. Root cause looks like GC + big-batch requests hitting quantized kernels. Followups: add a tail-latency metric to SLO dashboard, create runbook step to fallback to smaller batch-size. I'll open tickets today.
Oncall Bot: Incident created (INC-2024-07-21-73) — high latency on model-serving. Pager history attached.
Jordan: Thanks. Action items: 1) @Alex M update redis probe + post change in #eng-sre 2) @Priya S share replay job results here 3) @Sam L create SLO dashboard ticket and link to incident. I'll add a short note to handoff doc before handoff.
Casey R: Shared canary logs in the thread, TL;DR: a couple of 500s from the transformer worker when memory pressure + large batch aligned. Paste of the key lines:```
[2024-07-21T02:14:11Z] WARN transformer-worker mem_pressure=true batch_size=128 latency_ms=2345
[2024-07-21T02:14:12Z] ERROR request-handler code=500 msg="oom when allocating kv cache"
```
Priya S: Nice, that matches what the profiler showed. Plan: add soft cap on batch size for requests > 1024 tokens and re-run.
Alex M: I'll post the redis alert threshold diff in ~30m. Also scheduling a quick 15m sync if folks want to join in 45m to triage the incident followups.
Jordan: Sounds good. If anyone can't join, drop updates here. Otherwise I'll collect action items and add to the weekly reliability digest. :white_check_mark:
Sam L: Filing INC-2024-07-21-73 -> REL-245 to add metric and SLO doc entry. Assigning to @Sam L and @Priya S.
Alex M: Done — linking tickets. :rocket:
Jordan: End of check-in.
